description.zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量，默认值：20，最大值：200
description.en: The maximum number of records to read in this request. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 200.

description.zh: 标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始
description.en: The pagination token that marks the position from which to start reading. Leave empty to start from the beginning.

description.zh: StackId，Stack 创建后的唯一标识
description.en: The stack ID. The unique identifier generated after the stack is created.

description.zh:
资源栈配置状态
| 名称 | 描述 |
|------|------|
| Creating | 创建中 |
| Created | 创建完成 |
| Waiting | 等待部署中 |
| Deploying | 部署中 |
| Deployed | 部署完成 |
| Errored | 部署失败 |
| Deleting | 删除中 |
| Deleted | 已删除 |
| DeleteFailed | 删除失败 |
| DetectTriggered | 偏差检测触发成功 |
description.en:
The status of the stack configuration.
| Name | Description |
|------|------|
| Creating | Being created. |
| Created | Created. |
| Waiting | Waiting for deployment. |
| Deploying | Being deployed. |
| Deployed | Deployed. |
| Errored | Deployment failed. |
| Deleting | Being deleted. |
| Deleted | Deleted. |
| DeleteFailed | Deletion failed. |
| DetectTriggered | Drift detection triggered. |.

description.zh: 资源栈配置版本号，如：v1。初始值为 v1，每次资源栈更新或刷新且配置发生变更时，版本号递增。
description.en: The version number of the stack configuration, such as v1. The initial value is v1. The version number increments each time the stack is updated or refreshed and the configuration changes.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iacservice list-stack-configs --next-token s8UVlnE23gZvjCvCwkoZ7Z4dD+2BRJj42DLT6GrZysw= --max-results 20 --status Deployed --stack-id stack-as1d4vld898ppnqbxxxxx --biz-version v4 --api-version 2021-08-06 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iacservice GET /stacks/stack-as1d4vld898ppnqbxxxxx/configs --region cn-hangzhou --nextToken 's8UVlnE23gZvjCvCwkoZ7Z4dD+2BRJj42DLT6GrZysw=' --maxResults 20 --version v4 --status Deployed --header "Content-Type=application/json"
